Who is Veteran Racers?

The Veteran Racers are former Piston Cup racers in Cars 3. G.

Castlenut, Brian Spark, Tommy Highbanks, Bruce Miller, Bobby Roadtesta, Parker Brakeston, Floyd Mulvihill, Rev N Go Racer, Rev Roadages, Rex Revler, Darren Leadfoot, Apple Racer, Ponchy Wipeout, Murray Clutchburn, Ernie Gearson, Lightning McQueen, Ralph Carlow, Dino Draftsky, and Todd Marcus.
